profile.summary: Kernex Microsystems (India) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of safety systems and software services for railways in India and internationally. The company offers safety products for the railroad industry, such as LxGuard, a level crossing protection system; TrainSHIELD, a train collision avoidance system; SAFELx, a train actuated warning device; SENTINE
